title: Upgrade extension manifest
description: Manifest for Upgrade content identity, skill roots, and skill trait gates. The optional mcp block is launch data for the VS Code Upgrade host, not CLI plugin MCP configuration. Copilot CLI plugins register servers through plugin.json mcpServers (inline or a referenced mcp.json) or sub-agent YAML mcp-servers. The orchestrator does not launch or proxy extender MCPs.

id.description: Globally unique extension id. Doubles as the Copilot CLI plugin id and as the value scenarios use in `requires-extension`.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in diagnostic output and (future) marketplace listings.

version.description: SemVer of the extension itself, independent of the orchestrator version.

mcp.description: VS Code only: optional host registration and launch settings for this extender's peer MCP server. Not used by the Copilot CLI plugin runtime. Configure CLI servers in plugin.json mcpServers (inline or a referenced mcp.json) or sub-agent YAML mcp-servers instead. Omit for skills-only extenders.

serverName.description: VS Code host registration name and tool scope prefix, e.g. FabrikamUpgrade. When omitted, derived from the extension id. Must be unique; Upgrade is reserved for the orchestrator.

command.description: Executable to launch (e.g. `upgrade-dotnet-mcp` for a packed dotnet tool, or `dotnet` with arguments pointing at a DLL during in-repo testing).

args.description: Arguments for the VS Code host to pass to the server. The host resolves ${pluginRoot} against the manifest's folder. CLI native MCP configuration uses the different, case-sensitive ${PLUGIN_ROOT} token.

env.description: Optional environment variables passed to this MCP server when launched by the VS Code Upgrade host. Values must be strings. Not used by CLI plugin MCP registration; configure env in the native CLI server definition instead. Do not commit credentials or other secrets.

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory for the server. The VS Code host resolves ${pluginRoot} against the manifest's folder. Null uses the host's working directory.

enabled.description: Enables the extender's Upgrade content. Default true. Does not disable independently registered native MCP servers or their tools.

traits.description: Optional expression gating all skills from this extender, ANDed with each skill's own traits. Does not gate native MCP registration or tool calls. Grammar: atom (X), OR (X | Y), AND (X & Y or X + Y), NOT (!X), parentheses. Case-insensitive. Null / empty = always applies.

skills.description: Optional skill-root path(s) relative to the plugin root. When present, these roots are loaded in addition to the default `skills/` and `upgrade/skills/` directory-convention lookups — all skill layers are merged and skill-id collisions are deduped by the aggregator. Use to ship skills under a non-conventional folder or to expose multiple skill roots (e.g. shared base + scenario-specific). Paths that resolve outside the plugin root are rejected.
